name: G1
dof_breakdown: 23 DOF base; 23–43 on G1 EDU depending on wrist and three-fingered hand options
summary: A compact, foldable humanoid that Unitree sells from around US$16,000 — roughly an order of magnitude cheaper than most competitors — which made it the default hardware for academic locomotion and manipulation research almost overnight. The EDU version exposes low-level joint control and adds wrists and three-fingered hands.
notable: Widely adopted as a reinforcement-learning benchmark platform
